facts.text: Audrey and Andrew both express that nature brings them and their pets joy.

evidence.quote: Nature always makes us and our pets so happy.
Dogs and nature bring me so much joy and peace.

facts.text: Audrey mentions that her dogs love being outdoors and their faces light up when she prepares for a walk.

evidence.quote: They love it! It's their favorite part of the day! Their faces blightens up as soon as I get ready for a walk.

facts.text: Audrey shares a photo of her dogs playing with a frisbee in a meadow, which she says makes her happy.

evidence.quote: So check out how happy they are in this meadow! They make me so happy.
